result.topic_en: A scrap carrying a bibliographic note on the Mémoires de l'Académie des Sciences de Paris for 1784 and 1787, a pencilled note, a date and name, and scattered formulas written upside down relative to the text, apparently partial-differential expressions and series.

$\ldots = u$[?]
